summary: A 1959 R-6 flat-top lookout on a 20-acre Kootenai National Forest summit near Libby, Montana; the association is assessing it for restaffing.

30-ft pole L-4 tower per the association and firelookout.com; the register dates it to 1928
Married couple on the lookout in July, per a newspaper item
Married couple on the lookout in July, before their duties began, per a newspaper item
Present 32-ft treated-timber R-6 flat-top tower with catwalk built beside the older lookout; firelookout.com gives 30 ft
Condition assessment for restaffing; tower, catwalk and cab exterior in good condition; interior has basic restaffing equipment. The entry prints no date of its own.

notes_for_editor: Dates for the 30-ft pole L-4 disagree: 1928 (register), 1933 (association, firelookout.com), and a 1959 catalogue record says the older lookout was used from 1931. Height disagrees: 32 ft (register, association) vs 30 ft (firelookout.com); the record's height_m 9.1 equals 30 ft, so it may need review. Staffing and status are unclear: firelookout.com says staffed in summer (undated), the register says active, and the association describes a restaffing assessment. The association entry prints no date; the record's 2026 is taken from the 2026 projects page. The record's elevation (1614.2 m, 5,296 ft) matches the register and association; firelookout.com gives 5394 ft. The 2020 Libby District assessment in the record was not checked. No source says whether the cab is open to visitors.
